subjects.label: Forced publisher launcher
subjects.description: The mandatory launcher and extra platform pushed in by an update after the new publisher took over, and resentment of that publisher for it; general DLC pricing or patch complaints belong elsewhere.

subjects.label: Party composition and the meta
subjects.description: Which four heroes and roles to field together, the current version's answer, three-protect-one and double-tank setups, and the tedium of building four decks at once; single card or status interactions belong under status stacking.

subjects.label: Status effects and stacking
subjects.description: Poison, thorns, freeze and buff or debuff stacks as the engine of fights, whether run by the player or suffered from enemies; which heroes to pair belongs under party composition.

subjects.label: Hero roster and favourites
subjects.description: Individual playable heroes named as favourites, their animal and furry designs, and characters players want added as playable; the plot and dialogue belong under story.

subjects.label: Enemies and encounters singled out
subjects.description: Specific enemies, bosses and encounter types called out as unfair, memorable or badly tuned, such as minion spawners, chain-freezing bosses, doubled elites and the final boss; general difficulty talk belongs under difficulty.

subjects.label: Progression between runs
subjects.description: What carries over from run to run: hero unlocks, perks and skill trees, growth through failed runs, and losing that accumulated progress; in-run deck growth belongs under gameplay.

subjects.label: Run length and pace
subjects.description: How long a single run takes, battles that drag against high enemy health late in a run, and wanting a way to speed things up; total hours of content belong under content.

subjects.label: Finding a co-op partner
subjects.description: Needing someone to play with and struggling to find them, recruiting teammates or buying a copy for a friend so they will join; how the online play itself works belongs under multiplayer.
